caption:
Youi just went big on the Bash.

The insurer is now an official partner of the men's and women's Big Bash leagues, and it's backing five clubs too: Brisbane Heat, Hobart Hurricanes, Melbourne Renegades, Melbourne Stars and Sydney Thunder. It'll be on club kit through BBL|16 and on umpire uniforms in both comps, kicking off with WBBL|12 on Thursday. Length and value weren't disclosed.

Also on the board: TANK Juice with Auckland FC, 1KOMMA5° extending with Adelaide United, Green.com.au renewing with Sydney Thunder, Herbalife extending with Western Sydney Wanderers and Naver taking naming rights to Inspire Arena.
